units.summary: Adds an idempotent setter that appends the new `from-selected-series` hint to the block meta's hints and keeps the list sorted. That hint is written to meta.json on disk.
units.headline: New idempotent setter adds from-selected-series hint to block meta
units.reason: Writes a new value into the persisted meta.json format that compaction and WAL-replay decisions read.
focus: Older Prometheus/Mimir readers ignore the unknown hint, so they count these blocks towards inOrderBlocksMaxTime

units.summary: Adds a predicate that reports whether the hints list contains the `from-selected-series` hint. The planner, CompactBlockMetas, Write and inOrderBlocksMaxTime all branch on it.
units.headline: New predicate checks for the from-selected-series hint
units.reason: The predicate drives compaction planning and the WAL-replay cutoff.
focus: Every caller treats a block carrying both stale and selected hints consistently

units.summary: New unit test covering the round trip, idempotence and co-existence with the stale hint. Test-only, so no production effect.
units.headline: Unit test for selected-series hint setter and getter
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: The planner now splits blocks into three classes (stale, selected, no-hint) and plans each separately when more than one class is present, trying no-hint first, then stale, then selected. A block carrying both partial-view hints goes into the stale class; the merged result keeps both hints, so it stays excluded from the cutoff.
units.headline: Planner segregates selected-series blocks into their own compaction class
units.reason: Changes which blocks get merged, which affects the WAL-replay cutoff and the risk of data loss.
focus: Selected blocks are only planned after both no-hint and stale planning return nothing, so they can starve
Overlapping blocks of different classes are never merged, so overlaps stay on disk until retention removes them

units.summary: Only the doc comment changed, to mention the selected-series hint. The code is unchanged.
units.headline: planClass doc comment now mentions selected-series hint
units.reason: Comment-only change; no code lines changed.

units.summary: A merged block now gets the from-selected-series hint if any source block has it, matching how the stale hint is handled. The comments were rewritten to explain why.
units.headline: Merged block metas keep the from-selected-series hint
units.reason: Changes the persisted hints of merged blocks, which sets the WAL-replay cutoff.
focus: Any-source propagation: if segregation is bypassed, a mixed block is excluded from inOrderBlocksMaxTime (conservative, acceptable)

units.summary: Write now copies the selected-series hint from the base meta onto the newly written block, as it already does for the stale hint.
units.headline: Write carries the selected-series hint over from the base meta
units.reason: Changes the hints persisted on rewritten blocks.
focus: CompactSelectedSeries passes a configured meta, so the base path sets the hint as expected
